using pii = pair<ll, ll>;
using vi = vector<ll>;

    if (parent[x] == x) return x;
    return parent[x] = findParent(parent[x]);
}

void unite(ll x, ll y) {
    if (findParent(x) == findParent(y)) return;
    parent[findParent(x)] = findParent(y);
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    for (ll i = 0; i < p; i++) parent[i] = i;

    for (ll i = 1; i < p; i++) {
        if ((k * i) % p != 0) unite((k * i) % p, i);
    }

    for (ll i = 1; i < p; i++) {
        components.insert(findParent(i));
    }

    ll cycleCount = components.size();
    if (k == 1) cycleCount = p;

    ll result = 1;
    for (ll i = 0; i < cycleCount; i++) {
        result = (result * p) % 1000000007;
    }
    cout << result << "\n";
